title: Procedural Preview All Types
description: Extend procedural preview pipeline so point and vector outputs are rendered alongside geometry (curves, surfaces, solids). Unify into ProceduralPreviewItem model.
summary: Fixed 3D preview disappearing on flow canvas zoom. Flow wheel zoom persists fixture with updated camera, which triggered setFixtureJson and cleared previewItems. applyFixtureJson now compares widgets+synapses graph signature and only resets preview/selection when graph structure changes, not on camera-only updates.
